$comment: Contract for the SignOffRemediation server-side command (AD-003, command-concurrency skill). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_SignOffRemediation). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SignOffRemediation
customApi.description: T&C Manager validates a completed remediation action (BR-008, FR-023). Records an Approved or Rejected sign-off; a Rejected sign-off requires notes and returns the action to the adviser. Enforces the transition guard, optimistic concurrency and idempotency, and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_remediationaction to sign off.

requestParameters.name: Notes
requestParameters.description: Sign-off notes. Required when the decision is Rejected (BR-008).

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version of the action, for optimistic concurrency on a rejected reopen. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same sign-off.

responseProperties.name: SignoffId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_signoff record written for this command.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for an optimistic-concurrency conflict.
